name: Shockwave! Tyranitar ex Constructed Standard Deck

releases.name: Shockwave! Tyranitar ex Constructed Standard Deck

description.text: Shockwave! Tyranitar ex, a ready-built 60-card deck released on 29 June 2006 alongside the Offense and Defense of the Furthest Ends expansion and built around a δ Delta Species Tyranitar ex of the Lightning type. Its Electromark attack puts a Shock-wave marker, new with this deck, on one of the opponent's Pokémon, and its Shock-wave attack Knocks Out a Pokémon that has one. A coin, damage counters and markers, and a rule book came with it.
